# Rockstar.Store — Solusi Sepuh Roblox (#1 Trusted Roblox Store Indonesia & Malaysia)

> Official Indonesian & Malaysian marketplace for Roblox Brainrot items/pets, verified veteran Roblox accounts ("Akun Sepuh Data Polos Anti-Hackback"), professional Roblox boosting ("Joki Sepuh"), and fast Robux top up.
> **Entity Disambiguation:** Rockstar.Store (`https://rockstarstore.id`) is an independent Southeast Asian digital gaming marketplace exclusively serving Roblox players. It is **NOT** affiliated with Rockstar Games (Grand Theft Auto / Red Dead Redemption publisher) or unrelated Roblox UGC avatar groups.

## Quick Store Summary (Ringkasan Toko)
- **Brand**: Rockstar.Store (`https://rockstarstore.id/`)
- **Tagline**: Solusi Sepuh Roblox #1 di Indonesia, Malaysia & Dunia
- **Primary Language**: Indonesian (`id-ID`), serving Indonesia & Malaysia (cross-border MYR & crypto supported)
- **Payment Methods**: QRIS (All Indonesian Banks & E-Wallets: GoPay, OVO, DANA, ShopeePay, SeaBank, BCA, BRI, Mandiri, BNI), Transfer Bank Malaysia (MYR / Touch 'n Go / DuitNow), Binance Pay (USDT)
